title: SSC CGL English
summary: SSC CGL Tier I English past questions from 113 shifts, 2023 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question. A set of linked items counts as one question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 113 Tier I shifts, 2023 to 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC writes fresh questions for almost every shift; a word, idiom or paragraph it asks again is a repeat, and a grammar rule it keeps testing is a type. Vocabulary, idioms, cloze and comprehension passages are each their own fact, so they are not grouped into types. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
